## About ChitraFrame
ChitraFrame is India's premium online photo frame and wall art store. We sell high-quality framed art prints and poster prints shipped across India. Prices start at ₹499. Free shipping on orders ₹899 and above. COD not available; prepaid only.

## What We Sell
- Framed Art Prints: Premium wooden frames with your chosen design, available in 4 sizes
- Poster Prints: Print-only (no frame), available in 4 sizes at lower price
- White Mount Add-on: ₹250 extra — adds a white border mount inside the frame for a gallery look
